description: Before installing a remote MCP server, check its address: signals from the address itself (consumer tunnel, no TLS), the catalog listings with that address or host and their security level, and facts about its domain. Never visits the address. Send the endpoint URL. The answer never contacts that address: it reads what our weekly visits measured and what our domain data knows. `address_signals` comes from the address alone (consumer tunnel, `http://` without TLS). `records` lists the catalog listings with this exact address first (`exato: true`), then up to 20 others on the same host, each with its level and signals; `same_host` counts them all. `domain` has the facts about the host's domain. An address outside the catalog answers `no_catalogo: false` and `register`: submit it to get it reviewed. Cached for 5 minutes.

api_pass.description: MAT-only private pass: mat_<32 random hex>_<64 random hex>. Generate and save before buying.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.

url.description: The http(s) endpoint of the MCP server, without credentials.
